en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a coastal town with low, tile‑roofed houses, straight streets leading toward a harbor filled with masts of sailing ships, and a large mountainous island or headland across the bay. The image is surrounded by handwritten cursive text in the margins and across the bottom, with a short caption in printed letters just above the lower edge of the photograph.
